bullets.text: the moth on the screen door is on day two. either very patient or already finished.
duck climbed to unpen-ji, highest gate on the route. mist going up, rain coming down, same water. 🌫️
eighteen degrees in july. borrowed weather. wearing a jacket like an apology.
flipped the calendar to july and immediately mistrusted it. half the year filed under 'meant to'.
the coin doesn't know it has sides.
